title: Megurine Luka — An Idol's Knowledge〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori, nice work today♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your singing and dancing just keep improving! I can't wait hear how your show goes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! We'd do anything to see you perform!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Hearing that gives me a lot of confidence...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyways, I'll see you tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Minori?! Is everything okay?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'm just hungry and tired, so it's making me feel sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We did practice quite a lot. Please, make sure to rest and refuel when you get home♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And a nice long bath! Oh, but not too long. You might catch a cold!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori's really trying her best♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She is. I was a little worried that she was trying too hard but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? Are you still worried about her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Only a little bit. I mean, she's really putting everything into it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Relaxing is just as important as practicing, right? But I think she'll be fine now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right. A long shows do require quite a bit of stamina...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...! Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I thought of something good♪
Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Hm?
The next day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
Thanks for having me again today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's get started... Oh, but today's practice will feel a little different than normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! D-Does that mean it's going to be really hard...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That may be up to you, Minori.
Would you be up for it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Of course! Anything you ask!
Please, I'd like to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
In that case...
Minori, what's your favorite kind of fish?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Fish...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Such as tuna or maybe some other kind...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Salmon, maybe? It's so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ah, okay. We have tuna, salmon and...
Let's throw an otter in as well♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An otter? But otters aren't a type of fish...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But let's start with a tuna dance♪
Did you know that tuna fish have to keep swimming for as long as they can?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So I want you to...!
Do box steps as fast as you can♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And when I say, Salmon, I want you to start skipping like there's no tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And when I say, Otter, I want you to stop on a dime and start waving your hips all loosey goosey♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So let's start with... Tuna!
Faster! More! Like you mean it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka's way of showing Minori how to make her dance moves look more energetic!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: More energetic?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. For example, some groups try to have the audience focus on their lead by dancing more discretely, especially when they're singing, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, I think I understand what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And otter!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Loosey goosey...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Looser! Really swing them around, Minori! Relax more and let the waves move your body...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Loosey goosey...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good♪ Ride the waves just like an otter would and find where the otter on your shirt wants to go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Loosey goosey...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe! I wanna try that too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka! Mind if we join you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Everyone, like an otter!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, here we go♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hiii, Riiin. Hiii, Miiiku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe.
